verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Notte serves an llms.txt at docs.notte.cc/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that opens with a 'Critical Instructions For AI Agents' section pointing agents to the quickstart. Doc pages are also served as raw .md and include agent-directed guidance, such as the rule that element IDs must come from a live observe() call, plus guides for Claude Code agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus export, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
